title: Spreadsheet Structure and Clean Data
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting spreadsheet structure and clean data to Excel pivot-table finding with unit labels, source note, and claim-first chart title, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Audit a raw spreadsheet export against the four tidy-data rules (one header row, one value per cell, one record per row, consistent category labels) and name the analytical failure each defect causes
Diagnose and repair numbers-stored-as-text by reading default alignment and confirming SUM matches a hand count
Choose the correct repair tool (Text to Columns, Find and Replace, or row deletion) for a given structural defect
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
